compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When dso:approach-proposer is invoked with a remediation_context, its output begins with a DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration (token sourced from the shared-protocol doc) and contains an evidence quote from each reviewer-artifact path before any approach draft.

## Description

Edit plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md to add two additions, in this order:

1. **Inputs section addition** — under the existing `## Inputs` section (after the existing input subsections), add an optional subsection:

   `### Remediation Context (optional)`

   Declares `remediation_context` as an OPTIONAL input with sub-fields:
   - `reviewer_artifact_paths` (array of absolute paths) — reviewer artifacts that drive this delta cycle
   - `findings` (array) — structured findings each carrying at minimum a `target` (proposal id or n/a) and a `description`
   - `target_story_id` (string) — the story this delta cycle is scoped to

   State explicitly: when `remediation_context` is absent, the agent follows the existing protocol unchanged.

2. **DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub** — add a new top-level section titled exactly `=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===`. The stub MUST include:

   a. Reference to the DELTA OUTPUT template in the shared protocol doc (plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md or plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md — resolve at runtime).

   b. Two non-delegatable runtime rules restated inline:
      - **Pre-generation Read gate**: the agent MUST Read each absolute path in `reviewer_artifact_paths` BEFORE drafting any approach. The output MUST begin with `EVIDENCE FROM <path>:` blocks (one per reviewer-artifact path) containing a verbatim quote from each artifact.
      - **Preserve-by-omission**: proposals not named in any finding MUST be omitted from delta output entirely; only proposals explicitly named in `findings` appear in delta output with modifications.

   c. A pointer to the per-agent schema-preservation sub-section in the protocol doc (`### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer`).

The RED test (task d071-852d-27e6-4a86) must transition to GREEN when this task lands.

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- RED test now passes (GREEN transition) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-approach-proposer-remediation.sh
- Agent file contains the literal DELTA OUTPUT MODE token — Verify: grep -qF '=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md
- Inputs section contains the optional Remediation Context subsection — Verify: grep -qE '^### Remediation Context \(optional\)' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md
- Remediation Context subsection declares the three sub-fields — Verify: awk '/^### Remediation Context \(optional\)/,/^###|^## /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'reviewer_artifact_paths' && awk '/^### Remediation Context \(optional\)/,/^###|^## /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'findings' && awk '/^### Remediation Context \(optional\)/,/^###|^## /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'target_story_id'
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes EVIDENCE FROM format and pre-generation Read gate — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'EVIDENCE FROM' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qEi 'Read each absolute|pre-generation Read'
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes preserve-by-omission rule — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qEi 'preserve|not named in any finding|omit'
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub references protocol doc and approach-proposer sub-section — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'remediation-loop-protocol.md' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | grep -qE 'Schema Preservation — approach-proposer'
- Agent model directive remains opus — Verify: grep -qE '^model:[[:space:]]*opus' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md
- Pre-existing output schema still documented — Verify: grep -qE '"proposals"' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md && grep -qE '"distinctness_summary"' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md
